about_the_game:
A post-apocalyptic open-world adventure set among the ruins of a world destroyed by artificial intelligence.

After the rise — came the fall.

Humanity’s greatest creation turned against its makers, tearing civilization apart and leaving only scattered islands adrift in the endless sea. Centuries later, the last survivors rebuild what remains of the world — plank by plank, stone by stone, secret by secret. You are one of them — a stranger washed ashore with no memory, no past, and one burning question: What happened here?

In Landoff, you don’t just survive — you live.
Sail between islands on your boat without a map, guided only by beacons, NPC clues, and dialogues. Trade goods and contraband, fight bandits, earn influence across the archipelago, uncover relics of the fallen world, and climb the fragile social ladder of this broken civilization. Every island hides its own story, dangers, and forgotten technologies — remnants of the AI that nearly destroyed humanity in its attempt to save it.

Craft. Trade. Explore. Steal.

Upgrade your ship, forge alliances, and unveil the truth buried beneath layers of rust and coral. Will you become a wealthy merchant, a ruthless pirate, or a legend whispered across the seas? Force cities to work for you, sell your goods, hang your banners on billboards, and show your ambition to the entire archipelago!

Key Features:

Open World with Complete Freedom – Explore a vast archipelago shaped by storms, time, and forgotten machines.

Trading and Economy – Buy low, sell high, and build your fortune — or raid, explore, and sell your loot! Develop your own production and push your goods onto megacity shelves.

Exploration and Discovery – Every island holds mysteries, secrets, and lost memories of who we were — and what we became.

Combat and Survival – Engage in tense battles with bandits, creatures, and remnants of rogue AI.

Dynamic Atmosphere and Realistic Boats – Fight the waves and sail with realistic physics, balancing your cargo and survival at sea.

Deep Storyline and Quests – Piece together the truth about the cataclysm and your lost past, one clue at a time.

This is not just survival.
This is Landoff — a hauntingly beautiful, dangerous world where every wave hides a secret, and every decision shapes your fate.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of violence, blood, and scenes involving alcohol consumption.
Player discretion is advised.

name: Landoff

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K, AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K или AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Landoff is an open post-apocalyptic world shattered by artificial intelligence. Explore islands, trade, fight bandits, and uncover lost treasures to climb the social ladder and reveal the truth about who you are — and what happened to this broken world.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian*, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
